The last 2–3 positives are deliberately low-overlap paraphrases (a lexical miss on them is a proxy limit, not a routing bug). The negatives are ADVERSARIAL and each belongs to a NAMED other thing: the sharpest in-repo confusable is component-decomposer (zero-dep WEB components / Custom Elements — NOT Figma plugins); the token-FORMAT tools design-tokens-converter / ui-build-tokens / maintain-tokens (out-of-repo) own serialization between token formats, NOT plugin code; the Figma REST API owns SERVER-SIDE file/node reads (figma-plugins is the PLUGIN sandbox, not the REST API); the Figma design MCP owns 'design/generate a UI in Figma' (not building a plugin); and any *-decomposer 'grade X on two axes' request belongs to that family, not here. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
